title: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?

posts.topic_title: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.author: JayFritoes
posts.post_subject: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.content_md: I’ve read many different accounts. Some say you have to emboss the PET or BOPP film first, then metalize it. Some say you can directly emboss on pre-metalized PET or BOPP film.

posts.topic_title: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.author: lobaz
posts.post_subject: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.content_md: Both ways are possible. In case of pre-metallized film, a special composition is often used that comprises a layer of soft polymer that makes embossing easier.

posts.author: Din
posts.post_subject: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.content_md:
It's a touch more complicated. There are many ways to emboss onto plastic. I was the person responsible for transferring the image onto clear, metalised plastic at ABNH and there are several steps to transfer to plastic. ABNH also invented a different method to make transparent holographic film that I was not involved in.

Another method is used to make transparent holograms onto plastic to be applied onto a windscreen as HUDs on cars, which was used by Luminit .

Still another method is to record directly onto cleal plastic coated DCG. We, Joy and I, made some of these clear DCG coated film at Triple Take.

posts.topic_title: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.author: lobaz
posts.post_subject: Are embossed holograms embossed directly on metalized films?
posts.content_md: It depends on thickness of the metal (often aluminium) layer. A layer about 20 nm think shows quite good reflectance, but is still substantially translucent. So yes, it is typical that the metallized film is partially translucent.
